description: This file defines the AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider class, which implements storage provider and lifecycle participant interfaces for managing Azure Blob Storage append blobs within an Orleans-based application. It includes methods for initialization, creating storage instances, and participating in the silo lifecycle.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: A storage provider class for managing Azure Append Blob storage within Orleans, implementing lifecycle participation and storage creation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the storage provider by creating a client and initializing the container factory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AzureAppendBlobLogStorage for a given grain context.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the provider to the silo lifecycle to perform initialization during the runtime initialize stage.
